[[Tundoss' Shortbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[Tundoss the Destroyer]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Jahai Bluffs]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage|Piercing Dmg]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Life Draining]]: 5
:[[Health regeneration]] -1
:Health +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same skin as a [[Bramble Flatbow]] or [[Bramble Longbow|Longbow]] [[dye]]d  green + green + purple + black.
